title: Fix Sketchpad Model Asset Loading Across Store Providers
description: Investigate and fix semio sketchpad so 3D model files render in the scene for all supported store providers. Refactor provider-specific asset resolution and extend existing tests instead of creating new test files.
summary: Fixed sketchpad model asset loading by persisting kit file blobs through the configured file providers, resolving provider-backed files back into blob URLs for scene loaders, and extending the existing sketchpad test file with a provider-resolution regression covering memory, local, and mocked remote storage.
